# Application Kit (Applied AI – Pre-Sales Architect, KR)

This folder contains a lightweight submission bundle: cover letters, portfolio one-pager, requirement-to-evidence map, and demo runbooks.

## Files
- `portfolio_one_pager_en.md`
- `cover_letter_en.md`
- `cover_letter_kr.md`
- `requirements_to_evidence.md`
- `demo_runbook.md`
- `links.md`

## Build a shareable bundle
```bash
bash scripts/package_application.sh
```
